title: Axiom-PMO structured diagnostic contract
description: Shape of the JSON emitted by scripts/validate-project.ps1 -Format Json and scripts/assess-handoff.ps1 -Format Json. Consumers (CI annotations, dashboards, the thin CLI) read this contract, not the text report.

compatibility.unknown_field_behavior: Consumers MUST ignore fields they do not recognize. A future minor version may add fields; it will not remove or repurpose an existing one.
compatibility.absent_vs_null: Every field defined here is always present on every diagnostic. A field that does not apply to a given finding is emitted as null, never omitted and never an empty string.
compatibility.deprecation_policy: A field is first documented as deprecated in this file and in docs/reference/diagnostics-contract.md for at least one minor release before removal. Removal requires a major version bump of diagnostics_schema_version.
compatibility.breaking_change_signal: diagnostics_schema_version major component increments only on a breaking change. Consumers should refuse input whose major component is higher than they were built against.

exit_codes.0: No FAIL, and no blocking WARN when -FailOnWarning was passed.
exit_codes.2: -FailOnWarning was passed and at least one blocking WARN was emitted.
exit_codes.127: PowerShell host could not be located (emitted by the wrappers, not by the validator itself).

sensitive_data_policy.rule: Diagnostics locate a problem; they never reproduce the content of the problem.
must_not_contain: requirement or acceptance-criteria prose copied from PROJECT.md or DELIVERY.md
approval evidence text, approver contact details, or signature blocks
any content read from source/, MOM/, REQ/, Transcript/, or Others/
customer names, account identifiers, monetary amounts, or credentials
may_contain: artifact paths relative to the project root
governed identifiers such as REQ-001, D-002, TEST-003, DEC-004
table column names and section headings

project.description: Absolute path of the validated project.

schema_version.description: Repeated on every row so a single extracted diagnostic is self-describing when a consumer splits the results array.

rule_id.description: Stable since 1.0. Must exist in pmo-config/validation-rules.json; pmo-doctor DOCTOR-007 enforces this both ways.

message.description: Stable since 1.0. One sentence naming what is wrong. Subject to sensitive_data_policy.

blocking.description: Stable since 1.0. A blocking WARN turns into a non-zero exit under -FailOnWarning; a non-blocking WARN never does.

artifact.description: Project-relative path of the file the finding is about, e.g. DELIVERY.md or DESIGN/BUILD-SPEC.md. Null for findings that are not tied to one file.

item_id.description: Governed row identifier inside the artifact, e.g. D-002, REQ-001, TEST-003, or an approval gate name. Null when the finding is file-level.

field.description: Column or named section inside the row, e.g. 'Depends On', 'Owner', 'Evidence'. Null when the finding is row-level or file-level.

suggestion.description: Concrete next action. Defaulted from the rule catalog entry; a call site may override it with something more specific. Always null on PASS and INFO.

documentation_url.description: Resolved from validation-rules.json documentation_base_url + the rule's documentation path. Null when the rule has no doc page. Always null on PASS and INFO.
